description: Source code for sensor threshold interrupt handling in Zephyr RTOS, including interrupt setup, processing, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: tids_setup_threshold_interrupt
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for threshold handling.

methods.name: tids_handle_threshold_interrupt
methods.description: Handles threshold exceeded interrupt, disables further interrupts, and triggers processing.

methods.name: tids_process_threshold_interrupt
methods.description: Reads sensor status register and calls trigger handler if limit exceeded.

methods.name: tids_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets or clears threshold trigger and configures GPIO interrupt accordingly.

methods.name: tids_threshold_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback that invokes threshold interrupt handler.

methods.name: tids_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling threshold interrupts in own thread mode.

methods.name: tids_work_cb
methods.description: Work handler for threshold interrupt in global thread mode.

methods.name: tids_threshold_set
methods.description: Sets high or low temperature threshold limits.

methods.name: tids_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO and sensor thresholds for interrupt handling.
